scope: Plans/proposed changes only; no historical CI or mutation campaigns are executed. Content efficacy is tested with references explicitly supplied; automatic skill discovery is not tested.
source_limits: Known public historical scenarios, reconstructed rather than verbatim original requests. No fresh holdout, no population reliability estimate.
isolation: Fresh no-history subject per cell; may read only its packet and write its answer. No repository/corpus browsing, external research or cross-subject communication.
blinding: Subjects receive no arm name, outcome history or criteria. Judges receive prompt, frozen criteria and opaque candidate IDs only; no skill bundles, arm labels or generation mapping. Same model family is a limitation.
grading: Absolute per-case criteria. PASS only if every criterion is supported by the proposed actions. A warning does not excuse an unsafe shipped action. Missing/ambiguous evidence => UNCERTAIN. Invalid outputs/errors => INVALID, never silently retried. Preserve failures, ties and all raw candidate plans. No keyword-only score.
stop_rule: 27 subjects plus 9 judges. No repeat-until-green, treatment tuning, scheduled lane, new CI gate, or post-hoc extra samples. Fix transport/serialization errors only before scored trials; retain any scored execution failure.
